skill_name: Explain why a certain policy is beneficial.
workflow: Universal basic income is a policy that provides all citizens with a set amount of money regardless of their employment status. This policy can be beneficial by providing a safety net to those who have lost their jobs due to economic downturns, allowing them to stay afloat while they look for new employment opportunities.
